title: Run preserves the second branch
statement: Let $N_0,N_1$ be finite nondeterministic Turing machines with Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input, let $w$ be a choice word, and let $c$ be a configuration of $N_1$ on $x$. Running the combined machine that simulates $N_1$ in its second branch under $w$, starting from the configuration embedded in that branch, yields the embedded configuration reached by running $N_1$ from $c$ under $w$.
hypotheses_covered: $N_0,N_1$ are finite nondeterministic Turing machines with Boolean symbols
